payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the layer norm approximation significantly impacts performance, particularly in the context of the tasks discussed in the paper.

claims.text: The layer norm approximation incurs an average performance reduction of 1.08% in THE-X compared to the baseline model.
Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to a performance drop of 0.4% in the regression task STS-B.
The approximation error from layer normalization tends to accumulate in deeper transformer models, affecting overall performance.
